subject: POC hands-on benchmarking & kickoff — schedule coordination
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophia Perez <sophia@luminr.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC hands-on benchmarking & kickoff — schedule coordination

Hi Sophia,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a hands-on POC with Redwood. To make the kickoff productive we propose a 90-minute working session to cover:
- Prompt review and prompt-set run-through
- Routing & model variant configuration (canary + fallback)
- Load test overview and a short baseline run (throughput + tail-latency checks)

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Tue 21 Sep, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 22 Sep, 14:00–15:30

If neither works, give us 2–3 alternatives and we’ll iterate. Please also confirm who from your side will attend (dev/infra, security). I’ve attached a short draft load test plan for context.

Attachments: load-test-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on benchmarking & kickoff — schedule coordination

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the plan. Both slots are reachable for our team but we have a standing deployment window Wed morning that may make Wed afternoon tight. Tue 21 Sep is preferable.

Attendees tentatively: me (product/POC lead), Jorge Ortega (platform eng), and possibly a security rep (TBD). Would you be able to include an item to review test harness prerequisites? Jorge will want to validate container/networking requirements ahead of the run.

Also a quick ask: can you provision a dedicated instance for the short baseline run (so we can measure throughput without noisy neighbors)?

Sophia
Sophia Perez
Lead, POC — Luminr AI
sophia@luminr.ai

Hi Sophia — great, we’ll lock in Tue 21 Sep, 10:00–11:30 PT for the hands-on session. I’ll send a calendar invite and Zoom link once Monica confirms the tech prerequisites below.

Quick answers: yes, we can provision a short-duration dedicated capacity window for the baseline run — I’ll coordinate with the infra team and confirm the exact shape (GPU type + instance count) by EOD tomorrow.

Action items for your side:

I’ve added Marcus to keep him aware for billing/commit discussions.

Subject: RE: POC hands-on benchmarking & kickoff — schedule coordination

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 12:30 PM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I’ll send a calendar invite and Zoom link once Monica confirms the tech prerequisites below.

Hi all — a few technical items to unblock the harness and baseline:
- Pre-reqs: ephemeral SSH key for the harness controller, outbound access to our artifact registry (registry.redwood.ai:443), and permission to pull the test image redwood/load-harness:stable.
- Test harness: we recommend running the baseline in two phases — 1) 5-min warmup at 25% target load, 2) 10-min ramp to target throughput. Specify target throughput (tokens/s) and target p95 tail-latency SLOs. For Luminr we suggest an initial target of 1,200 tok/s with p95 < 350ms.
- Artifacts attached: test-harness-readme.md, sample-promptset.json.

If Jorge can share any constraints (e.g., NAT gateway egress limits) we’ll tailor the harness accordingly. I’ll create the calendar invite and attach the Zoom link + the baseline config.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: test-harness-readme.md (text)]
[attachment: sample-promptset.json (json)]
